'''Zeno Robinson''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Robinson was born on October 25, 1993. As a teenager, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of Western cartoons. Robinson joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where he voiced one of the main characters, [[Goh]].
